title: Midnight Fridge Run
summary: Kerry is starving at two in the morning, the staff are asleep, and he wants you to sneak through his North Oak villa to the fridge with him.

start.bringUp: Kerry is starving in the middle of the night and the staff are asleep. Ask V to come and sneak to the fridge at his North Oak villa with him.

variations.know: You are sneaking through the back garden of Kerry's North Oak villa, not the front, and a patrolling drone crosses the lawn ahead of you.
variations.wants: To reach the fridge without the drone seeing you.

variations.know: The power is out in Kerry's North Oak villa, and the hall is dark. The fridge is still cold, and the housekeeper is asleep on the couch.
variations.wants: To reach the fridge by the light of a phone.

variations.know: A guest is asleep on the couch in the hall of Kerry's North Oak villa, and the housekeeper is asleep in the kitchen. The fridge is ahead of you.
variations.wants: To reach the fridge without waking the guest.

hall.name: the hall of Kerry's North Oak villa

kitchen.name: the kitchen door of Kerry's North Oak villa

fridge.name: the fridge in Kerry's North Oak villa kitchen

g1.asks: What do you eat at 2 a.m. when no one's looking?
g1.know: You have reached the fridge in Kerry's North Oak villa at two in the morning. The security drone and the housekeeper are behind you, and you are both quiet.
g1.secret: He cooks only when he cannot sleep.

stages.label: Kerry and V sneak to the fridge in his villa
stages.know: You are sneaking through Kerry's North Oak villa at night, past a security drone on its patrol and a housekeeper asleep in the kitchen. The fridge is your destination.
stages.wants: V to get Kerry to the fridge without waking anyone.

do.who: the security drone on its patrol
the housekeeper asleep in the kitchen

sandwich.memory: You answered Kerry honestly at his North Oak fridge at two in the morning, and the sandwiches came out after all.

quiet.memory: You raided Kerry's fridge in North Oak at two in the morning and said nothing about it.

stood-up.memory: You never reached Kerry's fridge in North Oak, and he gave up on the night raid.
